paper_statement: Do NOT report unidimensionality of W1–W6 as evidence: null matrices with matched item variance and residual but no factor structure also yield one factor in 98% of replicates.
note: Null = additive item+variant means + iid residual (no common factor). Parallel analysis rule identical to O10 (200 normal PA draws per matrix). O10 reported one_factor for ALGO; item_var=0.011429.
